caveat: Fixed literature/marker functional proxies; not learned CM W/S/H, exact cell-subcluster recovery or validated clinical predictor.
coverage: 100% fixed requested genes present and variable for each arm and pan_T; no outcome-guided replacement. Missing/unmeasured gives unavailable primary slot.
scoring: Within-cohort (TCGA within cancer) per-gene average-tie percentiles across all eligible pretreatment/primary-tumor patients, equally averaged per panel. Joint=min(two panel scores). No outcome learning. OR/HR per SD on fixed complete-case design.
TCGA_samples: Only primary solid tumour barcode sample type01; repeated aliquots average gene expression within patient. Clinical duplicate conflicts quarantine. No assumed ICI treatment.
TCGA_gate: n>=60, events>=max(20,10*p),full design rank,condition<1e6. Stage sensitivity requires verified AJCC I-IV (pathologic first,clinical fallback), >=70% stage availability; never replace missing stage by zero.
TCGA_endpoint_caveat: PFI main prognostic question; OS secondary endpoint with TCGA-CDR disease limitations, both kept in full264-slot BH/BY. No pooled patient-level pan-cancer treatment model.
ICI_response: CR/PR (PRCR for Riaz) vs SD/PD; unknown stays missing. IMvigor uses original curated RESPONDER. Riaz onlyPre; Hugo onlypre-treatment; repeat same-patient pre samples average. Uncertain material/time explicit, no prediction claim.
ICI_models: Primary response logistic and survival Cox: joint+pan_T. Demographic/IFN/proliferation controls descriptive sensitivity when full design identifiable. n>=30; response minority>=10; survival events>=max(10,5*p); all failures retained.
ICI_increment: Secondary response LRT joint+armA+armB+pan_T vs armA+armB+pan_T; n>=80,minority>=20,full rank. Tests balance/co-enrichment beyond arms, not direct cellular interaction.
inference: Exploratory model likelihood-ratio P and Wald95%CI; complete-slot BH and BY separately per frozen question family, unavailable P=1 internally and NA shown. Independent logistic/ Efron partial-likelihood numeric audit required. No optimized cutpoints, AUC optimization, new survival event imputation or old HNSCC30-family refit.
source_independence: Different study accession from nine-source new CM discovery; patient aliases/cross-study overlap require provenance review. No reuse of old 20260906 CM interpretations.
public_payload: Code/frozen plan/provenance/audit status only; scientific coefficients and patient rows stay server and authorized chat.
